body.name: Separated regular face
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Reg}(p)\) holds when the operative positive-part signs, survivor-total comparison, and nonredundant lower and upper threshold optimizers of \(\Phi\) are unique with strictly positive slack in a neighborhood of \(p\), and the ordinary derivative \(A_p\) exists with \(A_p\Sigma(p)A_p^{\mathsf T}\) positive definite.
